import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# -----------------------------
# 1. Load the two provided csvs
# -----------------------------
crime_path = "chunks_csv/changespillover/changespillover_no2crime_crime_second_half_2012_to_first_half_2013.csv"
adj_path   = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

crime_df = pd.read_csv(crime_path)
adj_df   = pd.read_csv(adj_path)

# -------------------------------------------
# 2. Drop boroughs with any missing crime data
# -------------------------------------------
crime_df = crime_df.dropna(subset=["second_half_2012_value", "first_half_2013_value"]).reset_index(drop=True)

# Keep only adjacency rows where BOTH borough & neighbour are in the cleaned set
valid_boroughs = set(crime_df.borough)
adj_df = adj_df[adj_df.borough.isin(valid_boroughs) & adj_df.neighbor.isin(valid_boroughs)].reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------------------------------
# 3. Compute the change, Δ = 2013-2012
# ---------------------------------
crime_df["delta"] = crime_df.first_half_2013_value - crime_df.second_half_2012_value
delta = crime_df.set_index("borough")["delta"]

# ---------------------------------
# 4. Build symmetric, row-standardised W
# ---------------------------------
# Start with zero matrix (N x N) in a DataFrame to keep labels
boroughs = delta.index.tolist()
N = len(boroughs)
W = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=boroughs, columns=boroughs)

# Fill in 1s for neighbour pairs (make symmetric)
for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
    i, j = row.borough, row.neighbor
    W.at[i, j] = 1.0
    W.at[j, i] = 1.0  # ensure symmetry

# Row-standardise: divide each row by its sum (if sum>0)
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
for b in boroughs:
    if row_sums[b] > 0:
        W.loc[b] = W.loc[b] / row_sums[b]

# After row-standardisation, S0 = sum of all weights
S0 = W.values.sum()

# ---------------------------------
# 5. Compute observed Global Moran’s I
# ---------------------------------
x = delta.values
x_mean = x.mean()
x_dev = x - x_mean

# Numerator Σ_i Σ_j w_ij * (x_i - μ)(x_j - μ)
num = (W.values * np.outer(x_dev, x_dev)).sum()

# Denominator Σ_i (x_i - μ)^2
den = (x_dev ** 2).sum()

I_obs = (N / S0) * (num / den)

# ---------------------------------
# 6. Permutation test (999 permutations)
# ---------------------------------
perm_I = []
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=0)
for _ in range(999):
    perm = rng.permutation(x_dev)            # shuffle deviations
    num_perm = (W.values * np.outer(perm, perm)).sum()
    I_k = (N / S0) * (num_perm / den)
    perm_I.append(I_k)

perm_I = np.array(perm_I)
# Two-sided p-value
p_val = (np.sum(np.abs(perm_I) >= abs(I_obs)) + 1) / (999 + 1)

# ---------------------------------
# 7. Output
# ---------------------------------
data_points_used = N
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")
if p_val < 0.05 and I_obs > 0:
    verdict = "CLUSTERED"
else:
    verdict = "NOT CLUSTERED"

print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (test statistic = {I_obs}, p = {p_val})")
